Northwind Robotics - Company Overview and Working Hours

Northwind Robotics builds warehouse automation systems and employs about 600 people across three sites. Our head office is in Pune, with engineering centres in Bengaluru and Rotterdam.

Standard working hours are 40 hours per week. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time; outside these hours employees may arrange their day flexibly with their team. Meetings should not be scheduled before 09:30 or after 17:30.

Overtime must be approved in advance by the line manager and is compensated as time off in lieu, at a rate of one hour off for every hour worked, to be taken within three months.

Annual Leave

Every full-time employee receives 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, plus public holidays of the site they work at. Part-time employees receive leave in proportion to their contracted hours.

Leave requests are submitted through the PeopleHub portal at least two weeks in advance for absences longer than three days. Up to five unused days can be carried over into the next year; carried-over days expire on 31 March.

During the annual shutdown between Christmas and New Year, three days of leave are deducted automatically for all staff.

Sick Leave and Parental Leave

Employees who are unwell must inform their manager before 10:00 on the first day of absence. A medical certificate is required from the fourth consecutive day of illness. Sick days do not reduce the annual leave allowance.

Parental leave: the primary caregiver receives 26 weeks of fully paid leave, and the secondary caregiver receives 6 weeks of fully paid leave. Parental leave can be taken in up to three blocks within the first 18 months after the birth or adoption.

Employees returning from parental leave may work a reduced 30-hour week for up to six months without loss of salary.

Remote Work Policy

Employees may work remotely up to three days per week, subject to their role and team agreement. Roles that require physical presence in a lab or warehouse are excluded.

Working from another country is allowed for a maximum of 20 working days per year and must be approved by HR in advance, because of tax and insurance rules.

The company provides a one-time home office allowance of 25,000 INR for a desk, chair or monitor. Receipts must be submitted within 30 days of purchase. A stable internet connection of at least 50 Mbit/s is expected.

Business Travel and Expenses

Economy class must be booked for all flights shorter than six hours; premium economy is allowed for longer flights. All bookings go through the corporate travel agency TravelDesk.

The daily meal allowance is 2,000 INR within India and 60 EUR abroad. Hotel costs are reimbursed up to 7,500 INR per night in metro cities.

Expense claims, including photographed receipts, must be uploaded to the ExpenseFlow app within 14 days after the trip ends. Claims submitted later than 60 days are rejected. Alcohol and personal entertainment are never reimbursed.

IT Security: Accounts and Passwords

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must not be reused across systems. Passwords are no longer rotated on a fixed schedule; they must be changed immediately if a compromise is suspected.

Multi-factor authentication with the Authenticator app is mandatory for email, VPN and the source-code platform. Hardware security keys are issued to administrators.

Screens must be locked whenever a device is left unattended; laptops lock automatically after five minutes of inactivity. Sharing accounts or passwords with colleagues is forbidden.

Security Incident Response

Any suspected security incident must be reported within one hour to the security team via the hotline extension 4400 or the address soc@northwind.example.

Incidents are classified by severity. SEC-1 is a critical incident with active data loss and triggers the on-call crisis team immediately. SEC-2 is a confirmed compromise of a single account or device. SEC-3 covers suspicious activity that has not been confirmed.

A lost or stolen laptop is always treated as at least SEC-2: report it immediately so the device can be wiped remotely. Do not try to investigate an incident yourself.

Robot Controller Error Codes

The following codes appear on the display of the NX-7 robot controller.

ERR-4012: the licence server could not be reached. Check the network connection and renew the licence token in the admin console.

ERR-5520: the emergency stop circuit is open. Inspect the safety relay and release all emergency stop buttons before restarting.

ERR-6031: the gripper calibration has drifted beyond tolerance. Run the calibration wizard from the maintenance menu.

If an error persists after two restarts, open a ticket with field service.

Purchasing and Approvals

All purchases require a purchase request using form PR-22 in the procurement system before any order is placed.

Approval limits: purchases up to 50,000 INR are approved by the team lead; up to 5 lakh INR by the department head; anything above requires approval from the CFO. Three competing quotes are required for purchases above 2 lakh INR.

Software subscriptions must additionally be reviewed by the IT security team, regardless of their price. Personal credit cards may not be used for company purchases except for travel.

Office Facilities and Visitors

The Pune office is located in Building C of the Riverside Tech Park and is open from 07:00 to 21:00 on weekdays. Access outside these hours requires a request to Facilities.

Visitors must be registered in advance in the VisitorPass system and must wear a red visitor badge at all times. They have to be accompanied by their host in all areas beyond reception.

Employee parking is in the basement levels B1 and B2. Charging points for electric vehicles are available on level B1 and can be booked for four hours at a time.

Learning and Certifications

Each employee has an annual learning budget of 40,000 INR for courses, books and conferences. Unused budget does not carry over to the next year.

Certification exam fees are reimbursed in full when the exam is passed; a failed exam is reimbursed once. Employees who receive more than 1.5 lakh INR of sponsored training in a year agree to stay with the company for twelve months or repay a share of the cost.

Mentoring: every new engineer is paired with a mentor for their first six months. Mentors receive two hours per week for mentoring activities.

Data Retention and Privacy

Customer project data is retained for seven years after the end of a contract and then deleted. Recordings from warehouse cameras are deleted automatically after 30 days unless they are needed for an investigation.

Personal data of job applicants is deleted six months after the hiring process ends, unless the applicant agrees to a longer retention.

Requests from individuals to access or delete their personal data must be forwarded to the privacy officer at privacy@northwind.example within two working days. The privacy officer must answer within 30 days.
